validate_diplomacy_order: validate a Diplomacy game order string like 'F LON - BEL VIA' using InputValidator.ORDER regex
validate_diplomacy_message: validate a Diplomacy message string like 'England -> Turkey: msg [EO_M]' using InputValidator.MESSAGE regex
validate_diplomacy_phase: validate a Diplomacy phase string like 'S1901M' or 'W1901A' using InputValidator.PHASE regex
validate_joint_action: validate a multi-power joint action block with all 7 powers using InputValidator.JOINT_ACTION regex
validate_shortstate: validate a Diplomacy short state string with units and optional retreats using InputValidator.SHORTSTATE regex
